cues: At a potluck, thin slices add gentle sweetness and soft texture to a bowl of mixed fruit salad.
During a queasy morning, its mild flavor and softness make it an easy snack to keep down.
A small mashed portion can sweeten warm semolina porridge, making a plain breakfast more appealing.
At a family brunch, soft slices tucked into crepes add sweetness without requiring a separate dessert.
During gentle dog training, an owner may use a tiny soft fruit piece as an occasional reward.
In a warm conservatory, a broad-leaved tropical plant can create a lush focal point beside smaller houseplants.
